albums.name: Bad [Mixes 60]
albums.description:
Ampex 467 tape containing final mixes for the entire album, sequenced in order for mastering. Mitsubishi X-80 format, baked on June 9th, 2012 in preparation for Bad 25. Information taken from the original tape box sticker below the new one, which can be made partially visible through image manipulation. Some additional information is hard to make out or not visible. Oddly, it seems to be missing Leave Me Alone. Posted to Facebook on March 2nd, 2026 by retired producer and engineer Al Quaglieri.

albums.name: Song List
albums.description:
Handwritten list of songs found in Michael's room shortly after he died. Please note that all titles are in a random order on the sheet. "Cheater", "Scared Of The Moon", and "Beautiful Girl" are in a subsection of songs to finish.

Red Eye
Ways You Love Me (The Way You Love Me)
The Loser (I Was The Loser)
Best Of Joy
Lady Of Summer
Is She Coming Back ("Freeze" is written beside)
Beautiful Girl
D.I.E.
Dark Lady H2O (both titles written as one)
Bottom Of My Heart (From The Bottom Of My Heart)
Hold My Hand
Remember What I Told You (Just Remember)
Can’t Stop Loving You (Can't Stop Lovin' You) (has an arrow pointing to it with a note that might say "Melodine Now", presumably referring to "Melodyne")
Silent Spring
You Were There
Hollywood Tonight (Hollywood)
Shut Up And Dance
Rock Tonight
Adore You
Breath (Breathe)
I Am That One
Everybody Wants To Be A Movie Star
Don’t Walk Away
Barri Gibb MJ Song (unknown which MJ + Barry Gibb song this is referring to)
Coco Butter!
Scared Of The Moon (marked as a song to finish)
Beautiful Girl (written again, marked as a song to finish)
Cheater (marked as a song to finish)
Too Late To Turn Back Now
Ghost Of Another Lover
